Made-up GPX files, one per writer style the provider has been checked
against. Every name, place and time is invented; the shapes are what
real writers produce.

| file | writes like | exercises |
|---|---|---|
| `enterprise/2364-04-13 away team.gpx` | Geo Tracker | two-space indent, `<metadata>`, waypoints, per-point `extensions`, ` />` |
| `shuttlecraft/2366-09-02 Galileo survey.gpx` | Maprika | root attributes one per line, no indent, CDATA |
| `shuttlecraft/2367-06-01 Bozeman.gpx` | Maprika for Android | a point per line, two segments |
| `holodeck/2369-03-04 Sherwood.gpx` | My Tracks | CDATA everywhere, millisecond times, a point without `ele`, two points at one time |
| `routes/Course to Starbase 74.gpx` | a route planner | `rte`/`rtept` with no times, a self-closing point |
